variants.headline: Builder left unpaid for work done
variants.body: The client {client} has not paid {builder} for building work done. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A construction payment fails to arrive
variants.body: The builder {builder} is owed payment by the client {client} for completed work. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Work delivered, payment outstanding
variants.body: Payment for work done by {builder} has been missed by {client}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
